title: Kiss Me

cues.en: Yes, we are all out of the bearded barley
cues.zh: 是的，我們都擺脫了鬍鬚大麥
cues.text: Yes, we are all out of the bearded barley

cues.en: Lightly, lightly, reside the green, green rice
cues.zh: 輕輕，輕輕，綠綠色的稻子住著
cues.text: Lightly, lightly, reside the green, green rice

cues.en: Swing, swing, swing the spinning step
cues.zh: 擺動、擺動、擺動旋轉步
cues.text: Swing, swing, swing the spinning step

cues.en: You wear them shoes and that well, wear that dress
cues.zh: 你穿他們的鞋子，好吧，穿那件衣服
cues.text: You wear them shoes and that well, wear that dress

cues.en: Oh, kiss me, beneath the mermaids while I leave me
cues.zh: 哦，在我離開的時候，在美人魚的下面吻我
cues.text: Oh, kiss me, beneath the mermaids while I leave me

cues.en: Our long and moonless door is still open full
cues.zh: 我們長長的、沒有月亮的門仍然完全敞開
cues.text: Our long and moonless door is still open full

cues.en: Strike up the band to make the bar lies
cues.zh: 組樂隊，讓酒吧成為謊言
cues.text: Strike up the band to make the bar lies

cues.en: Then sell them on the spot, then
cues.zh: 然後當場賣掉，然後
cues.text: Then sell them on the spot, then

cues.en: So kiss me
cues.zh: 所以吻我吧
cues.text: So kiss me

cues.en: Kiss me down by the broken tree house, wing me
cues.zh: 在破碎的樹屋旁親吻我，給我翅膀
cues.text: Kiss me down by the broken tree house, wing me

cues.en: I've got to take you in time and bring a ring
cues.zh: 我得及時帶上你並帶上戒指
cues.text: I've got to take you in time and bring a ring

cues.en: Bring your flower in height
cues.zh: 讓你的花高高在上
cues.text: Bring your flower in height

cues.en: We'll take the trail mark down your father's map
cues.zh: 我們會在你父親的地圖上記下蹤跡
cues.text: We'll take the trail mark down your father's map
